Skin & wellbeing

Microdermabrasion

A consultation-led approach to skin resurfacing.

Ask about this treatment

Understanding your options

The practice describes microdermabrasion as an exfoliating skin treatment. Discuss your skin concerns, medical history, suitability and expected recovery with the practitioner. Results and the number of appointments vary.

What to expect

  1. Review your skin concerns and suitability.
  2. Discuss the procedure, limitations and possible side effects.
  3. Agree on aftercare and any follow-up appointments.

A common question

How is it different from microneedling?

Microdermabrasion focuses on surface exfoliation. Microneedling is a different procedure. Ask the practitioner to explain which, if either, is appropriate for your skin.

Your consultation is the place to discuss suitability, benefits, risks, alternatives and costs for your individual care.
